news.title: Hurricanes beat the Flyers 3-2 in OT for their first win as Aho scores 2
news.ruTitle: «Харрикейнз» обыграли «Флайерз» со счетом 3:2 в овертайме и одержали свою первую победу, а Ахо забил 2 гола.
news.description: — Sebastian Aho scored a pair of goals and assisted on Shayne Gostisbehere's overtime winner as the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Philadelphia Flyers 3-2 on Saturday night.

news.title: Senators open season with a 3-2 victory over the Maple Leafs
news.ruTitle: Сенаторы открывают сезон победой над «Мэйпл Лифс» со счётом 3:2.
news.description: — Stephen Halliday broke a tie at 9:46 of the third period, Linus Ullmark made 27 saves and the Ottawa Senators opened the season with a 3-2 victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Saturday night.

news.title: Lightning beat the Capitals 3-1 in home opener
news.ruTitle: «Лайтнинг» обыграла «Кэпиталз» со счетом 3:1 в первом домашнем матче
news.description: — Andrei Vasilevskiy made 19 saves, Charle-Edouard D'Astous and Conor Geekie scored in the first period and the Tampa Bay Lightning won their home opener with a 3-1 victory over the Washington Capitals on Saturday night.

news.title: Nick Schmaltz scores twice, reaches 500 points as Mammoth beat Blue Jackets 4-1
news.ruTitle: Ник Шмальц забивает дважды и набирает 500 очков, когда Мамонт обыграл Блю Джекетс со счетом 4–1.
news.description: — Nick Schmaltz had two goals and the Utah Mammoth scored three times on the power play to beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 4-1 on Saturday night for its second straight victory to open the season.

news.title: Jiri Kulich scores go-ahead goal, Sabres rally to beat the Blackhawks 4-3
news.ruTitle: Иржи Кулич забивает гол, "Сэйбрз" разгромили "Блэкхокс" со счетом 4-3
news.description: — Jiri Kulich scored with 6:40 left and the Sabres overcame a two-goal deficit to beat the Chicago Blackhawks 4-3 in Buffalo’s home-opener on Saturday night.

news.title: Lyle Odelein, Stanley Cup winning defenseman, dies at 58
news.ruTitle: Лайл Оделейн, защитник, обладатель Кубка Стэнли, умер в 58 лет
news.description: Lyle Odelein, a defenseman who won a Stanley Cup with the Montreal Canadiens in 1993 and played for several other NHL clubs through the 2005-06 season, has died at 58 years old, it was announced in social media posts by several of the teams he played for.

news.title: Panthers put Aleksander Barkov on long-term IR with leg injury
news.ruTitle: «Пантеры» отправили Александра Баркова на длительный срок из-за травмы ноги
news.description: Panthers center Aleksander Barkov has been placed on long-term injured reserve, meaning the injury to his left leg will keep him sidelined for at least the next 10 games.

news.title: Blackhawks' Bowen Byram to miss Buffalo return
news.ruTitle: Боуэн Байрам из «Блэкхокс» пропустит возвращение в «Баффало»
news.description: Blackhawks defenseman Bowen Byram will miss Saturday's game against the Sabres due to a family matter. Byram was set to make his first return to Buffalo since being traded to Chicago in June.
